target: Box-office ROI proxy = worldwide revenue / production budget - 1. Not investor profit.
point_estimate: Inverse-transformed squared-loss prediction of log(1+revenue/budget). This is not a calibrated conditional expected ROI or expected revenue.
features: poster HSV histograms, spatial RGB statistics, grayscale texture
image_encoder: Classical 73-dimensional pixel descriptors, not a pretrained neural embedding; no semantic claims.
text_encoder: TF-IDF up to 10,000 unigrams/bigrams, train-only truncated SVD up to 32 dimensions.
limitations: Poster-available complete-case cohort can introduce image availability selection bias.
Marketing/distribution costs and exhibitor splits unavailable.
Reported financial completeness creates selection bias.
Historical plots/posters may have been updated after release; pre-release provenance is unverified.
Temporal drift, franchises, extreme ratios and missing posters weaken generalization.
Probability of proxy ROI below zero is not loss severity or investment advice.
Residual intervals are broad, empirical and not guaranteed under temporal shift.
